questions.text:
(a) A compiler can broadly be divided into two phases based on the way they compile. Explain with a simple illustrative diagram. [6 marks]
(b) Explain the following types of compilers: (i) single pass compilers (ii) multiple pass compilers (iii) Compiler-Compilers (iv) Cross Compilers (v) Source-to-source Compiler [2 marks each = 10 marks]
(c) State any four (4) qualities of a good compiler [4 marks]
(d) State the tasks that are involved in lexical analysis. [3 marks]
(e) What are the important tasks performed by the parser? [7 marks]

(a) Discuss the reasons for including Error Handling routines in Compiler design and construction [6 marks]
(b) The use of an undeclared identifier in a program is an error. The error could have arisen in several ways. Discuss. [3 marks]
(c) Explain the following levels of error in compiler construction: Notes, Comments, Warnings, Errors, Fatal errors and Deadly Errors [3 marks]
(d) What are the wish list of a compiler error handler? [3 marks]

(a) The aspect of code generation in compiler construction is actually an arduous task. Why? [3 marks]
(b) The code generator should take some factors into consideration in order to generate the target code. Discuss any three of these factors [8 marks]
(c) Explain the alternatives available to a compiler designer to generate outputs after the quadruples, triples or the postfix forms of the source language have been generated [4 marks]

(a) What is Optimization in Compiler Construction? [3 marks]
(b) A code optimizing process must follow three rules. What are they? [3 marks]
(c) Explain with relative examples, the differences between Machine Dependent and Machine Independent Optimization techniques in Compiler Construction [6 marks]
(d) What is an "Unreachable Code"? How is it handled in Code Optimization? [3 marks]

(a) Discuss with a diagram the general overview of a compiler. [7 marks]
(b) What are the qualities of a good compiler? [3 marks]
(c) Give two similarities and two differences between compilers and interpreters. [4 marks]
(d) Differentiate between
(i) Compiler Pass and Compiler Phase. [3 marks]
(ii) Compiler-compilers and Cross compilers [3 marks]

(e) Given the grammar:
G = ({S, A, B}, {a, b, c}, { S→aA, A →bA, A →cB, B →bB, B → a}, S)
(i) Explain the four tuples that make up the grammar G [2 marks]
(ii) Obtain the derivation trees for the following sentences abbcba and acbbba [8 marks]

Given the grammar:
G = ({S, T, F}, { +, a, *, (, )}, {S →S + T/T, T →T * F / F, F → ( S ) / a}, S)
By Using a precedence matrix algorithm, show if a * (a + a ) is a sentence accepted by the language. [20 marks]

(a) Identify and explain any five significant routines necessary for implementing a semantic analyser. [5 marks]
(b) Explain any two intermediate languages that can be used in semantic analysis to re-write codes accepted by the syntax analyser. [3 marks each = 6]
(c) Consider the following FORTRAN code snippet:
DIMENSION A(100)
IF (A(I) .LE. A(J) ) GOTO 10
T = A(2 * (J + 1))
A(J) = A(I)
A(2) = T
10 A = A + B + C
Re-write the FORTRAN code snippet using a Semantic analysis intermediate language of your choice. [9 marks]

(a) Give any five sources of error in program design and implementation [5 marks]
(b) What is the purpose of error handling in compiler construction? [3 marks]
(c) Explain the tasks of error handling routine in compilers. [3 marks]
(d) Explain the different classifications of errors in compiler error diagnostics [9 marks]

(a) Give two reasons why a Computer Science Student must study the design and construction of compilers. [2 marks]
(b) Give two reasons why knowledge of Linguistic Analysis is very important in Compiler design [2 marks]
(c) Explain the following types of grammar:
(i) Context Free Grammar
(ii) Context Sensitive Grammar
(iii) Chomsky Type III Grammar
(iv) Precedence Grammar
(v) Operator Precedence Grammar [3 marks each = 15]

(d) Consider the following grammar productions
P1: aAb →acdeb
P2: A → cde
(i) Identify the type of Grammar applicable to the two productions above [2 marks]
(ii) Identify one sentence and one sentential form from the productions [2 marks]
(iii) Apply P1 on the following strings pqaAbr, fgcAb and aAc and make your Conclusions [3 marks]
(e) What grammar generates the following language? L(G) = {abk abk a / k >= 0} [4 marks]

(a) What is the importance of BNF in Compiler Construction? Given that A represents Numbers, B and C are digits, interpret the following BNF notations.
(i) A → B| [+ | - ] . C | B . C
(ii) A → B{B} [5 marks]
(b) Write an algorithm that uses a stack to convert an infix expression to its postfix equivalent [5 marks]
(c) Explain literarily or using algorithm how operator precedence parsing algorithm works [5 marks]

(a) Briefly explain with the aid of a diagram, the different phases of compilation [6 marks]
(b) Despite the many advantages of interpreters, compilers are still preferred. Discuss. [5 marks]
(c) Identify and explain the four alternatives for generating object codes in compiler construction [4 marks]

(a) Identify and explain any five significant routines necessary for implementing a semantic analyser. [5 marks]
(c) Explain any two intermediate languages that can be used in semantic analysis to re-write codes accepted by the syntax analyser. [3 marks each = 6]
(d) Consider the following FORTRAN code snippet:
DIMENSION A(100)
IF (A(I) .LE. A(J) ) GOTO 10
T = A(2 * (J + 1))
A(J) = A(I)
A(2) = T
10 A = A + B + C
Re-write the FORTRAN code snippet using a Semantic analysis intermediate language of your choice. [4 marks]

(a) Consider the following high level code, re-write the code using a Semantic analysis intermediate language of your choice.
sum = 0, j = 2
i = 1
10 sum += i + j
j++
i++
if i > 5 GOTO 10 [12 marks]

(b) What are the qualities of a good compiler? [3 marks]
(c) Give two similarities and two differences between compilers and interpreters. [4 marks]
(d) Differentiate between
(iii) Compiler Pass and Compiler Phase. [3 marks]
(iv) Compiler-compilers and Cross compilers [3 marks]
(e) Explain why a compiled program is faster than the interpreted one [5 marks]

(iv) A → B{B} [5 marks]
(b) Write an algorithm that uses a stack to convert an infix expression to its postfix equivalent [7 marks]
(c) Explain literarily or using algorithm how operator precedence parsing algorithm works [8 marks]

(a) Derive the grammar G that generates the language L(G) = {10k10n /k, n >= 0} [5 marks]
(b) Write short notes on the following grammars, citing relative examples:
(i) Chomsky Type I
(ii) Chomsky Type III
(iii) Ambiguous Context Free Grammars [5 marks each = 15]

(a) Explain the Code Optimization and Generation Phase of a compiler.
(b) What difficulties are usually encountered in code generation?
(c) What are the alternatives available for generating outputs in code generation?
(d) In between compilers and interpreters, which will you prefer and why? [5 marks each = 20]
